decisions.reason: Although this address autocomplete service is somewhat generic, it still builds on the firm's existing web-service and data-quality capabilities, and with in-house R&D the firm is likely to retain it unless it proves strategically peripheral.

An Austrian gas grid fee database is close to the firm's established regulated-energy data business, so its existing knowledge base should help it interpret demand and improve the offer rather than withdraw it quickly.

Peak load window determination is strongly related to the firm's core calculation, compliance, and process-support expertise, which makes continued learning and commercial application relatively likely.
The end-customer tariff database fits the firm's long-built database and analytics strengths and, as a multi-model product line, looks embedded enough in its platform direction to be worth keeping.

Custom web services clearly use the firm's existing software and service capabilities, but because the firm is moving toward more standardized SaaS and modular products, this offer faces a somewhat higher risk of being discontinued or absorbed.

A postal code lookup service is technically related to the firm's data-service skills but is comparatively generic and less central to its regulated-energy knowledge base, so management would be more willing to redeploy resources elsewhere.
